title: Cade's talk is a procedure dump, not character speech
body:
Cade’s talk is a **procedure dump** (LAY/CAST/DC/cattle-alarm, “Reviews choose nothing”, ALL-CAPS LURE/DRIVE/FORTIFY/HUNT) instead of a farmer in a wolf siege. This is the chapter’s voice, not a single blocked exit.

Grok-4.6 MCP wave: **17** `bugs[]` rows tagged as Cade-as-manual plus many more Cade lines; **13+** worst-moments named Cade’s first speech. Clarity averaged 2.45; 78/82 would not replay — this voice is a stated reason.

Fix: Cade’s plan comparison should stay in character. DCs and closed plans can live on the action/journal surface; his spoken lines should not be the rules document.

Evidence: grok-4.6 instant-thinking wave, 82 completed interviews, build `fe2619a8`. Not a duplicate of `4806c6f8ade14c0b` (action-id vocabulary).

evidence.summary: Grok-4.6 MCP wave cluster (17 mentions, 82 completed interviews).
